insight: Built by MiniMax, which listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange in January 2026; Talkie saw ~17M downloads in Jan–Aug 2024.
name: Talkie
tagline: Voice-first AI character chat — millions of companions to talk to or create.
description: Talkie is MiniMax's AI companion app: chat by text or voice with user-created characters across anime, fantasy, romance, and utility genres, with a memory system for conversational continuity and a card-collecting community layer. It became one of the most-downloaded AI companion apps in the US, second only to Character.AI.

modelSupport.notes: Runs on MiniMax's in-house frontier models.

edge: Higher-production voice and character multimedia than most companion rivals, backed by MiniMax's in-house frontier models.
cons: Pulled from app stores at times

references.title: MiniMax scores big in US with Talkie chatbot entertainment app
